General / Taker Fees
fees  =  round  up(M  x  0.07  x  C  x  P  x  (1-P))
round  up  =  rounds  up  such  that  the  fee  +  positionCost  is  rounded  to  a  centicent

Maker  Fees    fees  =  round  up(M  x  0.0175  x  C  x  P  x  (1-P))
round  up  =  rounds  up  such  that  the  fee  +  positionCost  is  rounded  to  a  centicent
